utility.name: Volatility 3 - memory forensics framework
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description:
Installs the Volatility 3 memory forensics framework into a venv and the bundled Linux symbol tables (ISFs) for the current Debian 12 base kernels. All bundled ISFs go into Volatility's symbol path and Volatility matches the right one to a memory image by its kernel banner.
NOTE: an ISF must match the kernel of the captured image, which (for a SecGen lab) is the newest kernel the base boots AFTER the post-provision reboot. Volatility analysis therefore only works for images captured from a base whose kernel is covered here. A capture from an uncovered kernel (a different distro, or a Debian base whose kernel has moved on) needs a fresh ISF - see the update-volatility-isf skill. The module's secgen_test runs post-reboot and fails with "NO BUNDLED ISF FOR: <banner>" when the running kernel isn't covered. This can't be a requires/conflicts: the module installs on the analyst workstation, not on the VM whose RAM is captured.
